description: Use to assess how ready a financial entity is for DORA, or to find its gaps. Call without answers to get the 39 questions in five pillars (ICT risk management, incident management, resilience testing, ICT third-party risk, information sharing), each with its DORA article. Call with answers (yes, partial, no per question id) to get a score per pillar, an overall readiness level and the gaps.

answers.description: Question id to answer, e.g. {"p1_1": "yes", "p2_3": "partial"}. Unanswered questions count as gaps.

name: dora_gap_assessment
title: DORA readiness gap assessment
